title: OL-20261112-94: Move ultrastable out of the Qniverse Cloudflare account
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** any tick whose token covers account 81e3a4efb4eb66e613529b87682911bb; daily cf-account probe
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/cf_account.py probe
**Status:** open

Backups taken 2026-11-12 (D1 SQL, Worker scripts, KV values; R2 bucket is empty). Route: cf_account.py copy then cutover, then delete the ultrastable resources from quniverse. Gated on a Cloudflare sign-in for the target account (identity-bound); default in effect: keep running in the old account. See deploy/cloudflare-accounts.json.
